rules.rule: Rulebook and reference config change only through web:review
must: adding or changing a rule belongs to\s+web:review

rules.rule: Production applies to .vue/.ts, Test to tests; Test inherits Production
must: apply Production to `\*\.vue` and `\*\.ts`, and Test to `\*\.test\.ts`
Test inherits Production unless a Test rule overrides\s+it

rules.rule: Mechanical rules live in the reference Biome config; the project config may add, never drop
must: it may add rules,\s+never drop one

rules.rule: Every response is checked into app types at the client boundary; no unchecked as T
Navigate by route name, never a string path
must: navigate with `\{ name, params, query \}`,\s+never a string path

rules.rule: Async read state goes through the one shared read helper
must: in the project's one shared read\s+helper, never in\s+hand-rolled refs per page

rules.rule: TSDoc summaries start with a verb or noun phrase, never the symbol's name
must: never with the symbol's own name

rules.rule: Tests fake fetch with METHOD /path keys and never mock own modules
must: keyed `"METHOD /path"` that\s+throw on any request not listed; never mock your own modules

rules.rule: Fixing runs bun run check before and after; never commits
must: Run `bun run check` in the root
the job is\s+not done until it passes

rules.rule: plan_first proposes the budget and stops before checking
must: propose the budget and the directory list, then stop for\s+the user's answer, checking nothing until it comes
